_readme: Lux Lotus 2027 line-up. Order follows the client's 30 Sep 2026 update: Sharon Gannon first, Ruth Lauer Manenti removed, everyone in one list with no local group and no city. Photos and bios marked rome-2026 are reused from the Rome template as temporary placeholders and must be confirmed by the client. Rendered by notes/tools/render-pages.py.

teachers.name: Sharon Gannon
teachers.bio: Sharon Gannon is the founder, along with David Life, of the Jivamukti Yoga method. She is a student of Shri Brahmananda Sarasvati, Shri Swami Nirmalananda, Shri K. Pattabhi Jois and Shri Shyamdas, and is an initiate into the Pushti Marg vaishnava sampradaya of Vallabhacharya through Shri Milanbaba Goswami. She has been called a pioneer in teaching yoga as spiritual activism and is credited with making yoga cool and hip – relating ancient teachings of yoga to the modern world. Sharon's book, Yoga and Veganism, has been called the "seminal" work on the subject, a ground-breaking work that explores the relationship of veganism to the teachings found in Patanjali's Yoga Sutras.

teachers.name: Yogeswari
teachers.bio: Yogeswari, based at the Jivamukti Yoga School in New York City since the year 2000, is a world-renowned Jivamukti Yoga teacher and is one of the most senior teachers in the method. Yogeswari is featured as one of the 100 most influential yoga teachers in the U.S. by Sonima. She is Advanced Certified, a facilitator of Jivamukti Teacher Trainings and has taken many Jivamukti Certified Teachers through one-on-one apprenticeships towards their 800-hour certification. Since 2004, she has been teaching around the world. Yogeswari is known for her vigorous, seamless Vinyasa sequencing and her thought-provoking philosophical teachings.

teachers.name: Camilla Veen
teachers.bio: Camilla Veen's first encounter with yoga was as a young child, when she observed her mother in odd positions while doing breathing exercises on the living room floor at home. Her fascination with yoga started even then! Camilla has practised yoga since the spring of 2000 and received the 300-hour certification as a Jivamukti Yoga teacher in the autumn of 2003. She is an Advanced Certified Jivamukti Yoga teacher and is currently one of the facilitators of the Jivamukti Yoga Teacher Training programme. Through her passion and confidence, Camilla has influenced many Jivamukti students on their path to becoming teachers and continues to galvanise the growing Jivamukti community in Scandinavia and Europe.

teachers.name: Petros Haffenrichter
teachers.bio: Growing up in different cultures, Petros Haffenrichter came to appreciate life as a union of polarities at a young age. Life is thrilling but demanding, beautiful but challenging, graceful but incomprehensible through mere logic. Through yoga, arts, music and acts of compassion, it is possible to learn to accept all parts of this play as equally significant and as opportunities for learning and insight. The key to developing an open mind and a thoughtful openness towards life is to keep one's curiosity and focus alive. Through yoga, he says, we develop finer levels of awareness, eventually finding that we hold the key to joy in our very hands as we learn to distinguish between conditioned behaviour and freedom.
teachers.bioSource: https://petrosyoga.com/about/ (petrosyoga.com, linked from his jivamuktiyoga.com profile, retrieved 30 Sep 2026)

teachers.name: Emma Henry
teachers.bio: Emma Henry was introduced to yoga in the mid-1990s and has been teaching since 1998. Her background in dance and martial arts is evident in her dynamic, innovative and playful choreography and understanding of anatomy and the subtle body. Emma's yogic path has led her to Mysore to practise Ashtanga with Shri K. Pattabhi Jois and to advanced certification in the Jivamukti method with Sharon Gannon and David Life. Her continuing education is shared with all of her students through her love of yogic texts and her amazing chanting. All of her classes include an inspiring soundtrack and a lot of laughter. Her goal is to create a space for practitioners to feel inspired, nurtured and uplifted.

teachers.name: Moritz Ulrich
teachers.bio: Moritz Ulrich is the co-director of Peace Yoga Berlin – Jivamukti Yoga School, an Advanced Certified Jivamukti Yoga teacher and a medical doctor. After having practised almost daily for several years, studying with different teachers from all yoga traditions, Moritz decided to start teaching yoga. This was over 10 years ago. While studying at Berlin Music College, he was eager to share his knowledge. After visiting the Jivamukti Yoga Center in Munich, he realised where he belonged. The love, the strength and the unlimited knowledge of Sharon Gannon (founder of the Jivamukti Yoga method) inspired him to dive deep into the path of yoga.

teachers.name: Martyna Febre
teachers.bio: Martyna Dharmina Febre is an Advanced Certified Jivamukti Yoga teacher and co-founder of the online platform Liberation Lab. Before she completely dedicated her life to practising and teaching yoga, she worked as an actress. Martyna is part of the Jivamukti Yoga Teacher Training faculty and has served as a mentor in the Jivamukti Yoga Apprenticeship Program numerous times. Currently based in Berlin, she teaches classes at Peace Yoga Berlin as well as retreats and workshops all over the world.

teachers.name: HaChi Yu
teachers.imageSource: client album JY TRIBE 2027 (30 Sep 2026): HaChi s:w07f12d08-27bd-4b6a-96b3-d8818ae2e764.jpg
teachers.bio: HaChi Yu was born and raised on the Lower East Side of NYC. She grew up dancing in the parks, sidewalks and theatres of the city, which she has been blessed to be doing in some form ever since. She was a professional ballet dancer in NYC for over 20 years. HaChi is an Advanced Certified Jivamukti Yoga teacher and serves as a facilitator for Jivamukti Yoga Teacher Training programmes. She was the founder and director of LaLaLå! Jivamukti Yoga Los Angeles, the first and only Jivamukti centre on the West Coast (which sadly closed during the pandemic). HaChi is also a certified teacher in Gyrotonic, the Pilates method and other movement modalities.

teachers.name: Anna Lunegova
teachers.imageSource: client album JY TRIBE 2027 (30 Sep 2026): Anna L.jpeg
teachers.bio: Yoga arose in Anna Lunegova's life when she was a student in the modern dance branch of the State Academy of Arts and Culture. She was interested in studying the diverse possibilities of the physical body in classical, folk and modern dance, and yoga. At the time, her interest in yoga was not strong and the idea of yoga was soon forgotten. However, her return to it later on was involuntary. Power, strength, endurance – these are the qualities that were necessary for her as a contemporary dancer of the Moscow Ballet troupe, and yoga helped her to cope with gruelling physical activities as a dancer and ultimately instilled in her a respect for Chaturanga Dandasana.

teachers.name: Magali Lehners
teachers.imageSource: client album JY TRIBE 2027 (30 Sep 2026): Magali.jpg
teachers.bio: Magali Lehners's yoga journey started in 1998, when a friend took her to her first yoga class during a stressful period of exams at high school. After that, she started to practise yoga regularly. Later, during her studies in Geography, Sociology and Ethnology in Heidelberg and Munich, she couldn't let go of it, and when she graduated, she travelled to India, eager to get to know the country where yoga originated. There, in a Sivananda ashram in the Himalayas, she did her first yoga teacher training course. Back in Munich, she discovered Jivamukti Yoga, in which she found her vocation, and undertook Jivamukti teacher training.

teachers.name: Alexandra Colombo
teachers.bio: Alexandra Colombo's yoga journey began during her pregnancy: she was amazed at how the practice helped her achieve physical and mental balance during this special period of life. Over time, she realised that yoga offered her the ability to grow into a more compassionate, strong and balanced human being. The more she immersed herself in yoga, the more she discovered its power to soothe her physical, mental and emotional state, no matter the circumstances. It was within Jivamukti Yoga that she found the method that truly resonated with her. She completed her 300-hour Jivamukti teacher training in India in 2015. In 2019, she co-founded Jivamukti Yoga Luxembourg, the first official Jivamukti centre in the country.
